annotations.title: The steps to go live (sends nothing)

description: When the person says to put it live: returns what going live does (every step, in order, and its cost) and the commands that do it (each starts npx -y @xgamesfun/solana@0.29.11 for this exact version: give them as they are). Going live is signed by a key file on the person’s own machine: `keygen` makes one for the project (it prints the address, never the key), and `approve … --keypair <file>` prints everything that would be sent and sends nothing until it is run again with the code it printed, which you do only after the person has read that printout and said yes. A live economy is changed only by the key that owns it: never make a new key for one. Never ask for, read or print a key, and open no signing page: the browser-wallet page (`approve … --browser`) is for a person who asks for one, or whose browser wallet owns the project, and they run it themselves.

example.description: A worked example by name (stud-farm, nft-raffle, …).

file.description: A JSON file holding the spec, relative to the project folder (default: xsolana.json when it exists).

spec.description: An economy spec (version 2) given inline. Takes precedence over file and example.
